definitions.explanation: A person who does not belong to a particular group, organization, or area, and therefore has no right to be involved or to enter.

examples.japanese: {部外者|ぶがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入り：10671_tachiiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Entry by unauthorized persons is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧べきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Outsiders should not interfere in this matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}した→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: Security was tightened so that outsiders could not enter the meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
{部外者|ぶがいしゃ} literally means "person outside the department/section." It is commonly used on signs restricting access and in discussions about who has the right to be involved in a matter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部外者|ぶがいしゃ}⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧ (no unauthorized entry)
- {部外者|ぶがいしゃ}お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (outsiders not welcome)
- {部外者|ぶがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exclude outsiders)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{第三者|だいさんしゃ}→第三者：26789_daisansha⟧ (third party) is more neutral and legal, while {部外者|ぶがいしゃ} emphasizes not belonging to the group in question. よそ{者|もの} (stranger, outsider) is more colloquial.
